ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 15:85 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black pigmentation across the central and inner lobe regions. High-intensity white pigmentation is mapped to the distal margins, specifically a contiguous band on the outer right lobe edge and fragmented spotting on the outer left lobe edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central notch with an approximate 85-degree interior angle and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:12.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2-8 pixels along the linear boundary; serrations are more pronounced and jagged on the right lobe margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve initiating from the median notch transitioning into a broad convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, brownish-white pixel groups situated at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular pixel loss and jaggedness at the extreme distal tips, accompanied by localized brownish-yellow pigmentation indicative of biofouling or surface trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in pigmentation mapping, with a much larger high-intensity margin on the right fluke lobe compared to the left.
